provenance: Phase 1 hand-written synthetic starter examples plus Phase 1.1 focused synthetic examples for ambiguous Electrical and Network / IT complaints. These are not real campus complaints.

phase1_1_additions.focus: Ambiguous electrical versus internet, network, and IT device failures.

synthetic_marking: Every row has a source column. Both source values are synthetic; no real campus complaint text is present.
label_source: Synthetic category labels aligned with the eight categories in the existing Flutter report form.
pii_review: No names, student IDs, contact details, credentials, addresses, or other personal information are present.
intended_use: Focused synthetic error analysis and baseline regression testing only.
collection_method: Hand-written from common campus facility, network, and IT support scenarios; no campus records or test examples were copied.
evaluation_protocol: Train on all non-holdout v2 rows and evaluate on the untouched 48-row Phase 1 baseline holdout. Near-duplicate groups are checked for holdout leakage.
notes: Do not describe this dataset or its metrics as production evidence. The additions deliberately over-sample the two confused categories and make the dataset intentionally non-uniform.
